title: Accept a First Payment in One Afternoon
description: Wire up Stripe Checkout into an existing product page, send a Resend confirmation email, and post a notification to a Slack channel so the business can demonstrate end-to-end payment acceptance by the end of the day.
prerequisites: Stripe account with test mode keys
Resend account with a verified sending domain
Slack workspace with an incoming webhook URL
A deployed web app or static site

steps.title: Create a Stripe account and grab test keys
steps.description: Sign up at stripe.com, switch to test mode, and copy the publishable and secret test keys from the dashboard.

steps.title: Add a Stripe Checkout button to the product page
steps.description: Use the official Stripe.js snippet to create a Checkout Session server-side and redirect the customer to Stripe's hosted page.

steps.title: Handle the webhook for completed sessions
steps.description: Register a webhook endpoint and verify the checkout.session.completed event signature before processing it.

steps.title: Send a confirmation email via Resend
steps.description: On a verified webhook event, call the Resend API to send a transactional 'Thanks for your order' email.

steps.title: Post a notification to Slack
steps.description: POST a formatted message to the Slack incoming webhook so the team sees the test payment in real time.

steps.title: Demo the end-to-end flow
steps.description: Run a test payment with the 4242 4242 4242 4242 card number and confirm the email and Slack notification arrive.

business_value: The business can accept a real customer payment and notify operations within a single working day, without building a billing system or messaging infrastructure.
